platforms.name: Mobile App
platforms.detailedDescription: The Undergrad is a C2C marketplace specifically designed to foster a safe, circular economy ecosystem within academic communities. The app restricts access by validating university email domains, mitigating fraud risks and facilitating intra-campus logistics. My role in this project was focused on the maintenance of a legacy codebase (React Native 0.61.5) and the stabilization of asynchronous architectures. I did not build the solution from scratch, but I was responsible for ensuring the reliability of the sales flow (including image uploads and value masking) and the efficiency of the real-time chat integrated with the Firebase ecosystem.
learnings: Maintenance of legacy React Native code structured predominantly with React Class Components and complex local state management.
Sustaining restricted B2B/B2C authentication flows, integrating Firebase Auth with API calls (System API) for rigorous validation of university domains.
Maintaining the trading ecosystem by handling complex forms involving monetary masking and image uploads (cropping and pushing to Firebase Storage).
Stabilizing synchronous/asynchronous communication architecture: maintaining a real-time chat interface coupled with Firebase Realtime Database and Cloud Firestore.
Managing fluid navigation interfaces and modals using react-navigation (v4) alongside native interaction libraries like SwipeListView.
Maintaining local data persistence (session tokens and preferences) using AsyncStorage within a Class Component architecture.
